summary: OneMain Finance Corporation filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $600 million offering of 7.125% Senior Notes due 2034. The notes are general unsecured obligations guaranteed by parent OneMain Holdings, but not by subsidiaries. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, possibly debt repurchases. This is a routine debt issuance under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. No deal terms involving equity or corporate event are present.
